main.name: HULA
main.source: Approximated from NSDI 2016 HULA results (Fig 7/8) showing significant reduction in queue length and FCT compared to ELB.

arch_a.name: ELB
arch_a.source: Approximated from trends in SIGCOMM 2012 ELB paper (Fig 6/7) indicating higher state lookup latency and queue buildup.

arch_b.name: HULL
arch_b.source: Approximated from NSDI 2015 HULL paper (Fig 5) showing intermediate performance between HULA and ELB.
